title: Hushed Kenyan Mango Wrap
description: Earthy, glassy-jelly style wrap with mango, brine‑dry dates, glace cherry, and a subtle coconut glaze, served fresh in a ti leaf.

ingredients.name: ripe mango
ingredients.notes: peeled and sliced into thin strips

ingredients.name: glassjelly mango puree
ingredients.notes: use a commercial or homemade puree

ingredients.name: toasted sesame seeds
ingredients.notes: lightly toasted in a dry pan

instructions: Warm the ti leaf wrappers over a low flame until pliable.
Spread a thin layer of glassjelly mango puree over each leaf.
Arrange mango strips, dates, glace cherries, coconut water, mint, sesame seeds, lime zest, and a pinch of salt in the center of each leaf.
Fold the sides of the leaf over the filling and roll tightly to seal.
Place the wraps on a steamer tray and steam for 2 minutes to meld flavors.
Remove from heat and allow wraps to cool for 1 minute.
Serve wraps warm or at room temperature, garnished with extra mint if desired.
Enjoy the subtle, earthy, and glassy-jelly experience.
